points.why: Names Fixes That Fail and explains that the coupon cuts complaints right away while its delayed side effect, peak orders, worsens lateness.
Traces the reinforcing side-effect loop explicitly but only implies the quick-fix balancing loop and never lays it out as a loop.
Ties the 30% proposal to the dose rising for the same relief and advises against it.
Recommends a bridge-and-taper approach, an off-peak-only coupon, fixing peak capacity, and tracking on-time rate by night and the Fri/Sat redemption share.

pitfalls.why: Never calls the situation Shifting the Burden.
